create_pipeline_qwenimage_controlnet: create a QwenImageControlNetPipeline instance with transformer, vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, scheduler, and controlnet modules
run_pipeline_qwenimage_controlnet: run the QwenImageControlNetPipeline __call__ method to generate images from a text prompt and control image using controlnet conditioning
encode_prompt_qwenimage: encode text prompts into Qwen2.5-VL hidden state embeddings with attention masks for the pipeline
prepare_control_image_qwenimage: prepare and encode control images through the VAE into packed latent representations for controlnet conditioning
calculate_shift_scheduler: calculate the shift parameter mu for the FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length
